identity.name: Unusual AWS Credentials Creation via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker creates AWS credentials using PowerShell to establish persistence and exfiltration capabilities. Cortex should detect the unusual process behavior and credential creation activity.
identity.description: An attacker creates AWS credentials using PowerShell to establish persistence and exfiltration capabilities. Cortex should detect the unusual process behavior and credential creation activity.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: AWS Credential Creation Process
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process creating AWS credentials
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'New-AWSCredential'
| filter action_file_path contains '.aws/credentials'

abiocs.name: Unusual AWS Credentials Creation
abiocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process creating AWS credentials outside of normal user context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'New-AWSCredential'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: AWS Credential Creation Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'New-AWSCredential'
| filter action_file_path contains '.aws/credentials'
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, action_file_path
